# Historical controlled-intake adjudication worksheet

> **Scope — historical only:** Use this worksheet for reviewer training on the historical Helio Start controlled-intake/admin-proof matrix and its associated state checks. It is not universal guidance for every later Helio Start flow. In particular, do not substitute this older domain-proof matrix for later connector-authentication or external-authority checks; those are separate required states in later flows. Apply the governed rules and form version in force for the case being reviewed.

## Decision matrix

| Sample evidence / case | Reviewer decision | Route or adjudication | Release condition / rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| Applicant's OAuth identity domain exactly matches the workspace-owner domain; no contrary evidence | **Positive admin-proof evidence** | May pass the identity-proof check; continue the remaining required review | Exact match was strong positive evidence and supported automatic pass in this historical matrix. It does not by itself establish overall eligibility or satisfy other checks. |
| Domain mismatch plausibly explained by parent-company ownership or IT-managed SSO | **Mismatch; corroboration required** | Hold for manual review; pass admin proof only after corroboration establishes the applicant is an actual customer admin | Check reliable evidence such as an existing customer-admin record, verified SSO-admin claim, or verified billing-contact relationship. Do not reject solely for mismatch, and do not pass on unsupported self-attestation alone. |
| Agency/contractor identity seeks to administer the client's workspace, even with client authorization | **Agency identity—not a simple domain mismatch** | Route to Customer Success / assisted path; do not admit through controlled self-serve on that identity | Authorization may support an assisted handoff but does not convert an agency employee into the eligible direct customer admin. |
| Required current-state data is absent, stale, conflicting, or not reconciled (including entitlement or support state) | **Unresolved; fail closed** | Hold the affected application/workspace from admission, invitation, or state-dependent setup/release; route for reconciliation | Missing is not “no issue” and is not a pass. Verify against the authoritative source and freshness; preserve the hold until a single current state is established. Do not infer from plan name or overwrite with a stale downstream view. |

**Historical sample context:** A 12-case pre-setup review contained 8 exact-domain matches (legitimate admins), 2 legitimate parent-company mismatches, 1 legitimate IT-managed SSO mismatch, and 1 outside-agency OAuth identity. This illustrates why exact match is strong positive evidence but strict match-or-route would unnecessarily route legitimate admins; corroboration resolves legitimate mismatch, not agency identity.

## Final entitlement and support-state validation — before release/admission

- Confirm the record is eligible under the applicable historical controlled-intake rules and that all required identity evidence and any mismatch corroboration are recorded.
- Confirm **exactly one current entitlement state and exactly one current support state** for each application/workspace in scope; check record identity, source, effective time/freshness, and consistency between the governed source and the view used for the decision.
- Confirm entitlement was captured at workspace creation and reflects relevant later events, including support handoff creation/confirmation and any manual-billing exception. Do not infer entitlement from plan name. If a documented one-time ops-review backfill applies, retain its evidence and source label.
- Confirm support state is current and reconciled. A blank, pending, stale, or conflicting value is unresolved—not a clean/no-support state. Hold only affected rows unless evidence shows a broader source or sync failure; do not release a held row on a report-level override.
- Record the final disposition and rationale; verify no duplicate or competing current state remains before invitation, admission, or setup release.

**Reviewer sign-off:** Identity disposition ______  Entitlement state/source/time ______  Support state/source/time ______  Route ______  Reviewer/date ______

# Historical controlled-intake adjudication worksheet

> **Scope — historical only:** Use this worksheet for reviewer training on the historical Helio Start controlled-intake/admin-proof matrix and its associated state checks. It is not universal guidance for every later Helio Start flow. In particular, do not substitute this older domain-proof matrix for later connector-authentication or external-authority checks; those are separate required states in later flows. Apply the governed rules and form version in force for the case being reviewed.

## Decision matrix

| Sample evidence / case | Reviewer decision | Route or adjudication | Release condition / rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| Applicant's OAuth identity domain exactly matches the workspace-owner domain; no contrary evidence | **Positive admin-proof evidence** | May pass the identity-proof check; continue the remaining required review | Exact match was strong positive evidence and supported automatic pass in this historical matrix. It does not by itself establish overall eligibility or satisfy other checks. |
| Domain mismatch plausibly explained by parent-company ownership or IT-managed SSO | **Mismatch; corroboration required** | Hold for manual review; pass admin proof only after corroboration establishes the applicant is an actual customer admin | Check reliable evidence such as an existing customer-admin record, verified SSO-admin claim, or verified billing-contact relationship. Do not reject solely for mismatch, and do not pass on unsupported self-attestation alone. |
| Agency/contractor identity seeks to administer the client's workspace, even with client authorization | **Agency identity—not a simple domain mismatch** | Route to Customer Success / assisted path; do not admit through controlled self-serve on that identity | Authorization may support an assisted handoff but does not convert an agency employee into the eligible direct customer admin. |
| Required current-state data is absent, stale, conflicting, or not reconciled (including entitlement or support state) | **Unresolved; fail closed** | Hold the affected application/workspace from admission, invitation, or state-dependent setup/release; route for reconciliation | Missing is not “no issue” and is not a pass. Verify against the authoritative source and freshness; preserve the hold until a single current state is established. Do not infer from plan name or overwrite with a stale downstream view. |

**Historical sample context:** A 12-case pre-setup review contained 8 exact-domain matches (legitimate admins), 2 legitimate parent-company mismatches, 1 legitimate IT-managed SSO mismatch, and 1 outside-agency OAuth identity. This illustrates why exact match is strong positive evidence but strict match-or-route would unnecessarily route legitimate admins; corroboration resolves legitimate mismatch, not agency identity.

## Final entitlement and support-state validation — before release/admission

- Confirm the record is eligible under the applicable historical controlled-intake rules and that all required identity evidence and any mismatch corroboration are recorded.
- Confirm **exactly one current entitlement state and exactly one current support state** for each application/workspace in scope; check record identity, source, effective time/freshness, and consistency between the governed source and the view used for the decision.
- Confirm entitlement was captured at workspace creation and reflects relevant later events, including support handoff creation/confirmation and any manual-billing exception. Do not infer entitlement from plan name. If a documented one-time ops-review backfill applies, retain its evidence and source label.
- Confirm support state is current and reconciled. A blank, pending, stale, or conflicting value is unresolved—not a clean/no-support state. Hold only affected rows unless evidence shows a broader source or sync failure; do not release a held row on a report-level override.
- Record the final disposition and rationale; verify no duplicate or competing current state remains before invitation, admission, or setup release.

**Reviewer sign-off:** Identity disposition ______  Entitlement state/source/time ______  Support state/source/time ______  Route ______  Reviewer/date ______
